entries.summary: Owner status shortcode now shows plain-English labels instead of raw status strings
entries.notes: Map: in_review=Under Review, verified=Verified, completed=Certificate Ready. Unknown statuses fall back to ucwords.

entries.summary: No-submission message now includes the active award year for context
entries.notes: Was: No award submission found. Now: No submissions found for the 2026 haunt award season.

entries.summary: Added Most Outstanding Haunted Campsite award category with [oha_campsite_award_submit] shortcode
entries.notes: New class-campsite-form.php. Open to non-logged-in submitters. Fields: campground name, location, contact name/email, description, optional photo. Stamps _oha_award_type=campsite and _oha_award_year on every entry. Uses same CPT, status flow, year isolation, and cert workflow as actor awards.

entries.summary: Campsite award has its own independent open/close, bypass token, and email settings in Awards > Settings
entries.notes: is_submissions_open() now accepts a  param (actor or campsite). Campsite section added to register() with its own fields. Does not share toggle/date/token with actor award.

entries.summary: Admin table now has Type column and Type filter (All / Haunt Actor / Campsite)
entries.notes: get_view_type() added. prepare_items() and export_csv() both respect type filter. Actor filter includes legacy entries with no _oha_award_type meta (NOT EXISTS OR actor). Column methods (haunt_name, owner, actor_name, character_name, reason) are all type-aware.

entries.summary: CSV export now correctly reads the year filter
entries.notes: get_view_year() previously only checked  but the export form POSTs the year. Now checks  as fallback. Same fix applied to type filter via get_view_type().

entries.summary: Email templates are type-aware - campsite entries use campsite-specific templates and placeholders
entries.notes: build_replacements() adds {campground_name}, {contact_name}, {contact_email}, {location}, {award_type}. send_cert_ready, send_admin_notice, and send_submitter_confirm all check _oha_award_type and select the right template.

entries.summary: Owner dashboard [oha_awards] shows type badge and type-appropriate fields per entry
entries.notes: Red badge for Haunt Actor, blue for Campsite. Campsite cards show campground name and location instead of actor name.

entries.summary: Replace check_admin_referer with wp_verify_nonce to prevent wp_die on nonce failure
entries.notes: check_admin_referer calls wp_die if nonce is missing or expired - bots/crawlers hitting admin-post.php triggered this and the error page got cached site-wide causing white screen. Now redirects back to referer or home_url on failure.

entries.summary: Replace wp_die on missing required fields with redirect in campsite form handler
entries.notes: Avoids any wp_die call path in handle_submit - redirects with oha_campsite_error=1 param instead.

entries.summary: Replace all smart/curly quotes with ASCII straight quotes in class-email.php and class-settings.php
entries.notes: LLM generated code with Unicode curly quotes (U+2018/U+2019) instead of ASCII apostrophes - PHP cannot use these as string delimiters, causing fatal syntax error on activation. 155 in class-email.php, 1 in class-settings.php.
